exposure: Endometrial thickness (≤7 mm, >7 to ≤10.9 mm, >10.9 to ≤13 mm, and >13 mm)
Women undergoing assisted reproductive technology treatment
cohort: 4637 women without previous cesarean delivery who conceived by in vitro fertilization or intracytoplasmic sperm injection-embryo transfer treatment and subsequently delivered at the Third Affiliated Hospital of Guangzhou Medical University between January 2008 and December 2020
finding: Thin endometrial thickness (<7 mm) is an independent risk factor for placenta accreta spectrum in women without previous cesarean delivery undergoing assisted reproductive technology treatment, with a clinical significance slightly lower than that of placenta previa.
